decided: The brief refuses, naming it, a change's requirement file that states no added, changed, removed or renamed requirement, a capability folder without that file, a change's own description file (the one naming its program and stage) that it cannot read, and a folder it cannot open; it does not run the full check orbit runs before a change is applied.
alternatives: run the full check on every requirement file, which would refuse 19 of the 66 changes archived in this repository
refuse only a file that cannot be read at all
why: A brief is shown whole or not at all, so it must not show a file it could not read, or one it read nothing from, as a change with no requirements; the full check holds today's rules, which many earlier archived changes were never written to, and would leave their briefs refused for good.
detail: program-brief.ts: readCapabilities refuses a spec.md whose parseDeltaSpec plan is empty and a specs/<cap>/ with no spec.md; listDir refuses any readdir error but ENOENT; readMeta refuses an unparseable .openspec.yaml. Measured: Validator.validateChangeDeltaSpecs rejects 19 of 66 archived changes; no archived delta spec yields an empty plan; no .openspec.yaml fails to parse.
